statements.statement: The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The service billed was CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The denial was on medical necessity grounds

statements.basis: denial_letter states CO-197 indicates required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained

statements.statement: The clinical indication note documents recurrent presyncope and dizziness
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology given the patient's history of atrial fibrillation
Continuous ambulatory mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm
The service was ordered to rule out high-grade conduction disease or sustained arrhythmia
The patient has a diagnosis of atrial fibrillation
